facts.text: The user wants the Tasks screen to support task management for editing, reallocating information, and reassigning documents to another tagger.
The user wants the Tasks screen to allow changing a task status when a tagger finishes annotating.
The user wants the Tasks screen to move tasks to a review stage after tagger completion.
The user wants the Tasks screen to change a task status to completed after checker approval.
The user wants the Tasks screen rewritten as a functional specification including use cases, flows, actions, and UI design.
